description_en: Exports monitoring data defined in the Cursor operation
description_zh: 导出在Cursor接口中定义的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms-export batch-get --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric cpu_idle --cursor  --length 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGet

parameters.help_en:
The data namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the data namespace of a cloud service, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html.

This parameter must be the same as the Namespace request parameter in the Cursor operation
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于如何获取云产品的数据命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html。

本参数必须与Cursor接口中的请求参数`Namespace`相同
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The metric name of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the metric name of a cloud service, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html.

This parameter must be the same as the Metric request parameter in the Cursor operation
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的监控项名称。

关于如何获取云产品的监控项名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html。

本参数必须与Cursor接口中的请求参数`Metric`相同
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The cursor value that must be specified when you call this operation in a loop to export data. You can obtain the cursor value by using the following methods:

When you call this operation for the first time, call the Cursor operation to obtain the cursor value. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/391206.html.

When you call this operation again, obtain the cursor value from the response of the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
循环调用本接口导出数据时，必须输入`Cursor`的值。`Cursor`值的获取方法如下：

当您初次调用本接口时，必须先调用Cursor接口，获取`Cursor`的值。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/391206.html。

当您再次调用本接口时，可以从上次调用本接口的返回数据中获取`Cursor`的值
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records returned per request.

Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh:
每次最多返回的数据条数。

取值范围：1~10000
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en:
The compression type of the monitoring data.

Only `normal` (no compression) is supported
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的压缩类型。

目前仅支持`normal`（不压缩）
parameters.name: compression_type

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist of statistical methods for the metric.

If this parameter is not specified, monitoring data of all statistical methods for the metric is returned.

If this parameter is specified, only monitoring data of the statistical methods in the whitelist is returned.

For information about how to obtain the statistical methods of a metric, see the `Statistics` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
监控项统计方法的白名单。

如果不设置该参数，则表示返回监控项的所有统计方法的监控数据。

如果设置该参数，则表示仅返回白名单中统计方法的监控数据。

关于如何获取监控项的统计方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html中的参数0
parameters.name: record_key_white_list
